attack.name: Sanjun's Pounce

pattern.chargeDesc: Explosive short rush, claws first. It commits — the lane is locked at the crouch.

attack.telegraph: It crouches low, tail lashing once, twice. The stripes go still. Then it comes.

attacks.name: Sanjun's Pounce

pattern.chargeDesc: Explosive short rush, claws first. It commits — the lane is locked at the crouch.

attacks.telegraph: It crouches low, tail lashing once, twice. The stripes go still. Then it comes.

attacks.name: Raking Claws
attacks.telegraph: A paw rises, claws out — casual, almost lazy. It is not lazy.
It stops mid-prowl, ears flat. Blood on its muzzle, sides heaving. The mountain lord has decided you are not worth dying for — it melts back into the bamboo.

codexStages.observed: An Amur tiger. The System classified apex predation as 'inefficient hierarchy' and tried to improve it — bigger, patient, and convinced the mountain is a throne. It kills with a throat bite after the rush. It expects prey to run. Everything it has ever eaten ran.
codexStages.slain: Moves: Sanjun's Pounce (charge, telegraphed by the crouch — the lane locks early), Raking Claws (close range), Withdraw (below 25% hp). It never chases what stands its ground and shouts — the chase instinct needs a runner. Meat: a tiger feeds the village for a week. The pelt is beyond price.
codexStages.unknown: The bamboo went still in a way that had nothing to do with wind. Then the stripes resolved.

counter.hint: Running wakes the chase in it. It has eaten everything that ever ran.
counter.reveal: When it crouches to pounce, STAND TALL and SHOUT — bang metal, wave your arms, be loud and enormous. It expects prey to flee. Be the thing that doesn't, and the pounce dies unlaunched.

curious: It sits, enormous, and watches you the way weather watches a field.
fearful: It backs off a pace, ears flat — the noise is wrong and it doesn't like wrong.
warn: The tail starts lashing. This is the last warning anything ever gets.

edible.note: A tiger feeds the village for a week. The pelt is beyond price; the claws are trade and talisman both.

encounter.comment: Sanjun: stalk->crouch->pounce. Pounce lane LOCKED at the crouch (commitCharge). Shouting during the crouch (counter kind 'shout') breaks the pounce and may rout it. Missed pounce -> winded one turn (soft flanks). Withdraw below 25%.
encounter.knownCue: It crouches before the pounce — tail lashing, stripes still. Shout THEN, not after.
encounter.knownTactics: Never run. Stand tall and shout during the crouch; sidestep the locked lane.

loot.note: Alien loot: low chance, tier scales with monster strength (Steve 2026-10-05).

name: The Mountain Lord
unknown: stripes resolving out of the bamboo, watching you
vibe: the mountain lord — silent, patient, already decided
weaknesses: shout it down during the crouch — it expects prey to run
the pounce lane locks early; be elsewhere when it lands

attack.name: Belly-Drum Thunderclap
attack.telegraph: It rears up on its hind legs, belly swelling drum-taut, and beats it with both paws — BOOM.

attacks.name: Belly-Drum Thunderclap
attacks.telegraph: It rears up, belly swelling drum-taut, and beats it with both paws — BOOM. The air itself flinches.

attacks.name: Trickster's Feint
attacks.telegraph: It waddles left, then is suddenly right — a feint, testing whether your eyes or your ears are in charge.

codexStages.observed: A raccoon dog. The System found tanuki folklore — the belly-drumming shapeshifter — and decided the folklore was understating things. The belly is a drum, the drum is a weapon, and the waddle is a lie: it is exactly where it means to be.
codexStages.slain: Moves: Belly-Drum Thunderclap (burst sonic, telegraphed by the swelling belly — strike the taut drum during the inhale and the shockwave backfires), Trickster's Feint (repositioning nip). It can't chase; it waddles. Keep your ears on the drum, not your eyes on the waddle. Meat: fatty and dark.
codexStages.unknown: BOOM. Out of the dark, a drumbeat with no drummer. Then another, closer.

counter.hint: The drum must swell before it sounds. The inhale is the tell.
counter.reveal: When the belly swells drum-taut, STRIKE — the stretched skin is thin as a drumhead and the thunderclap backfires, stunning it senseless. Hit the drum, not the drummer.

curious: It sits up and drums a little paradiddle, watching to see if you flinch.
fearful: The drumming falters into a nervous patter. It waddles backward, belly deflating.
warn: It rears up. The belly starts to swell. You know what comes next.

edible.note: Fatty, dark, faintly of thunder. Cook it well — and thank the drum.

encounter.comment: Drum-Belly: waddle->swell->thunder. Striking during the swell (counter kind 'strike_windup') pops the drum: the thunderclap backfires, stunning it 2 turns. Missing the window means eating the burst.
encounter.knownCue: The belly swells before the thunder. Strike the taut drum.
encounter.knownTactics: Hit it while it inhales — the stretched belly is fragile. Don't chase the waddle; wait for the swell.

loot.note: Alien loot: low chance, tier scales with monster strength (Steve 2026-10-05).

name: Drum-Belly
unknown: a drumbeat with no drummer, getting closer
vibe: a trickster with a war drum for a stomach — playful until it isn't
weaknesses: strike during the inhale — the taut belly is fragile
it waddles; it cannot chase — control the distance
